/**
 * Mutual recursion: a folder holds entries, an entry holds folders.
 */
@Serializable
public data class Folder(
    public val name: String,
    public val leaves: List<Leaf>? = null,
)

/**
 * The other half of the cycle.
 */
@Serializable
public data class Leaf(
    public val title: String,
    public val folders: List<Folder>? = null,
)

/**
 * A node that holds a list of itself — direct recursion.
 */
@Serializable
public data class Tree(
    public val label: String,
    public val children: List<Tree>? = null,
)
